flags.title: Vitamin C does not prevent colds
flags.evidence: A review of placebo-controlled trials found regular vitamin C did not reduce how often people in the general population catch colds.

citation.title: Vitamin C for preventing and treating the common cold

sourceQuote.text: The failure of vitamin C supplementation to reduce the incidence of colds in the general population indicates that routine vitamin C supplementation is not justified
